name: agents-panel
description: Agents panel (/agents-info): running and finished subagents with model, context, cost and time, plus a cost line under each Agent call. Optimized fork of johnnyvizz/claude-kit (MIT), without savvy-flow.

language.title: Panel language
language.description: auto follows Claude Code's language setting, then the system locale; en, ru, he (Hebrew, drawn right to left) or vi

autoOpen.title: Open the agents panel
autoOpen.description: any: open the panel when the first subagent of the session starts; off: only with /agents-info

subagentCacheTtl.title: Subagent cache-write price
subagentCacheTtl.description: 5m: cache writes at 1.25x input (what Claude Code subagents write); 1h: at 2x input, as the original

rowCost.title: Cost under each Agent call
rowCost.description: on: a line under each Agent tool call in the transcript with that subagent's model, tokens, estimated cost and time; off: none
